"""Publish Main-reviewed diagnostic evidence and retire only closed duplicates."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, importlib.util, json, re
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W=G/'feat-prefill-gated-region-alias-20261013'
N=G/'feat-phase-prefill-12k-20261013'
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-13-gated-region-alias-diagnostics'
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('publication_owner', B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(sp.origin)=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def safe(v,key=''):
 if isinstance(v,dict): return {k:safe(x,k) for k,x in v.items()}
 if isinstance(v,list): return [safe(x) for x in v]
 if isinstance(v,str) and key!='sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',v): return dict(sha256=v)
 return v
def dump(p,v):
 p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(safe(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def archive(p,target): dump(target,dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),text=p.read_text()))
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-gated-region-diagnostics-publication-root-v1'; assert not out.exists() and not F.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],evidence={},main_reviewed=True,adopted=False,gpu_executed=False)
 def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 env=load(B/'main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-root-v2/record.json')['environment']
 def run(label,args,allowed=(0,)):
  print('PUBLICATION '+label,flush=True)
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=300,cpu=1800,rss_cap=2<<30,text_cap=8<<20,total_cap=32<<20)
  r['evidence'][label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return so.read_text().strip()
 try:
  assert run('head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])=='fd595aa7ef34bc04d16c2f385f0d62f09c8f3adc'
  assert not run('local-identity',['git','config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],(1,))
  run('author-identity',['git','var','GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
  names=['main-phase-head-alias-8k-model-lifetime-root-v1','main-phase-head-alias-12k-admission-root-v1',
   'main-phase-12k-negative-admission-closure-root-v1','main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-root-v1',
   'main-prefill-gated-region-full-lints-root-v1','main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-root-v2',
   'main-prefill-gated-region-full-lints-root-v2','main-prefill-gated-region-12k-model-lifetime-root-v1']
  receipts={name:load(B/name/'record.json') for name in names}
  assert all(not x['active'] for x in receipts.values())
  old=receipts[names[1]]; assert not old['passed'] and not old['complete'] and old['error']=="AssertionError('engine-phase-lifetime')"
  failed_lint=receipts[names[4]];assert not failed_lint['passed'] and len(failed_lint['novel_findings'])==1
  assert 'clang-analyzer-cplusplus.NewDeleteLeaks' in failed_lint['novel_findings'][0][3]
  assert all(x['passed'] and x['complete'] for name,x in receipts.items() if name not in (names[1],names[4],names[-1]))
  actual=receipts[names[-1]]
  assert actual['complete'] and 'error' not in actual
  assert actual.get('phase_engine_lifetime_qualified') or actual.get('expected_guard_rejection')
  for name,x in receipts.items():
   for c in x['commands']:
    if name==names[1] and c['label']=='engine-phase-lifetime':
     assert c['session_anchored'] and c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and not c['survivors'] and not c['cleanup']
    else: assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored']
  build=receipts[names[5]]; lint=receipts[names[6]]
  assert build['source_pins']==lint['source_pins']==actual['source_pins'] and lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
  assert all(m.sha(W/k)==v for k,v in build['source_pins'].items())
  for mode in ('free','contrib-llvm'): assert m.sha(W/'build'/mode/'strata')==build[mode]['binary_sha256']
  assert actual['binary_sha256']==build['free']['binary_sha256']
  assert set(run('dirty',['git','diff','--name-only']).splitlines()+run('new',['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard']).splitlines())==set(build['source_pins'])
  F.mkdir();pins={};deletions=[]
  for name,x in receipts.items():
   p=B/name/'record.json'; pins[str(p)]=m.sha(p)
   compact={k:v for k,v in x.items() if k not in ('evidence','stdout','stderr')};compact['evidence']={}
   for label,e in x.get('evidence',{}).items():
    if label=='source-diff':continue
    if 'lints' in label:
     compact['evidence'][label]=dict(summary='Actual mapped findings retained in receipt; repeated full diagnostic text retired.',stdout_sha256=m.sha(B/name/'commands'/(label+'.stdout')),stderr_sha256=m.sha(B/name/'commands'/(label+'.stderr')))
    elif label=='engine-phase-lifetime':
     selected=[line for line in e['stderr'].splitlines() if re.search(r'phase-|head-lease|prefill scratch alias|prefill gated alias|configured=|prompt start|prompt end|queue-completed host/device handoff|non-finite|FAILED|ZE_RESULT_ERROR|ERROR',line)]
     compact['evidence'][label]=dict(stdout=e['stdout'],stderr_progress=selected,full_stderr_bytes=len(e['stderr'].encode()),full_stderr_sha256=c['logs']['engine-phase-lifetime.stderr']['sha256'] if (c:=next(v for v in x['commands'] if v['label']==label)) else None)
    elif label.startswith('kernel') and '-cursor' not in label:
     compact['evidence'][label]=dict(summary='Cursor, fault filter/counts, relevant findings and dump status retained in kernel_checks; unrelated full journal text retired.')
    else:compact['evidence'][label]=e
   if 'evidence' not in x and 'stdout' in x:compact['supervisor_stdout']=x['stdout']
   dump(F/'receipts'/(name+'.json'),dict(original_path=str(p),original_sha256=m.sha(p),record=compact))
   for c in x['commands']:
    for kind in ('stdout','stderr'):
     path=B/name/'commands'/(c['label']+'.'+kind)
     if not path.exists():continue
     expected=c['logs'][path.name]['sha256'];assert m.sha(path)==expected
     # Main's immutable original JSON stores exact bytes; compact evidence is additionally archived.
     assert x.get('evidence',{}).get(c['label'],{}).get(kind)==path.read_text()
     deletions.append(dict(path=str(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=expected,replacement=str(F/'receipts'/(name+'.json')),reason='Closed duplicate command stream; immutable original receipt retains exact bytes and status, committed report retains reviewed evidence'))
  controllers=['main-phase-head-alias-8k-model-lifetime-v1.py','main-phase-head-alias-12k-admission-v1.py',
   'main-phase-12k-negative-admission-closure-v1.py','main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-v1.py',
   'main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-v2.py','main-prefill-gated-region-full-lints-v1.py',
   'main-prefill-gated-region-full-lints-v2.py','main-prefill-gated-region-12k-model-lifetime-v1.py',
   'main-gated-region-diagnostics-publication-v1.py']
  for name in controllers:archive(B/name,F/'controllers'/(name+'.json'))
  reports=['research-scratch-alias-runtime-fixture-round388-v1.txt','research-bench-warmup-autotune-scope-round389-v1.txt',
   'research-bench-warmup-autotune-scope-round389-v2.txt','implementation-gated-region-alias-v1.txt',
   'research-persistent-vram-second-gen-round390-v1.txt','research-gated-alias-independent-audit-round391-v1.txt','research-chooser-admission-state-bound-round393-v1.txt']
  new=[]
  for name in reports:
   target=F/'research'/(name+'.json');archive(B/'research-20261009'/name,target);new.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)),sha256=m.sha(target)))
  prior=N/'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-prefill-12k-host-qualification/report-registry-v191.json'
  assert load(prior)['research_completed']==932
  dump(F/'report-registry-v192.json',dict(research_completed=939,prior=dict(path=str(prior),git_revision='fd595aa7ef34bc04d16c2f385f0d62f09c8f3adc',sha256=m.sha(prior)),new_reports=new,main_only_test_execution=True,main_corrections='R389 v1 inspected HIP/CUDA and is out of scope; v2 corrects actual SYCL GDN chooser. Retain both unchanged. Main made Linux unknown-owner child termination explicit after all assertions; first new lint failure preserved.'))
  summary=dict(source_parent='fd595aa7ef34bc04d16c2f385f0d62f09c8f3adc',source_pins=build['source_pins'],free=build['free'],contrib_llvm=build['contrib-llvm'],host=build['phase-host'],asan_ubsan=build['phase-host-asan'],lints_qualified=True,novel_findings=[],first_failed_lint_status_preserved=True,old8k_actual_lifetime_pass=True,old12k_original_diagnostic_failed=True,old12k_capacity_outcome_reviewed=True,old12k_first_short_request_complete=True,old12k_second32768_not_admitted=True,old12k_fresh_free_drop_bytes=897024000,old12k_free_drop_cause='unattributed',old12k_postfailure_gpu_health_pass=True,actual_gated12k_lifetime_qualified=actual.get('phase_engine_lifetime_qualified',False),actual_gated12k_guard_rejected=actual.get('expected_guard_rejection',False),actual_gated12k_requests=actual['requests'],actual_gated12k_chunk_rows=actual.get('actual_chunk_rows'),actual_gated12k_capacity_ledgers=actual.get('capacity_ledgers'),actual_gated12k_layouts=actual.get('actual_gated_layouts'),actual_gated12k_normal_quit=actual.get('normal_quit'),actual_gated12k_kernel_checks=actual.get('kernel_checks'),source_requested_gate_savings_bytes=503316736,quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,performance_samples=[],performance_method='Unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3 only',upstream_client_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d',diagnostic_timings_not_speed_evidence=True,default_phase_cache=0,default_gated_alias=0,adopted=False,reset_executed=False,service_changes=False,research_registry_count=939,next_step='Production fixed-prefix serve logits/state/RESTORE/full262144 checks; then matched official8K/12K capacity comparisons and separate decode repetitions. Runtime retained memory attribution remains open.')
  dump(F/'summary.json',summary)
  good=bool(actual.get('phase_engine_lifetime_qualified'))
  ja_result='候補は 1,024 と 32,768 token の fresh GEN を完了し、通常 QUIT と後続 GPU 確認も通りました。' if good else '候補も空き容量の guard で停止し、拒否した要求は未完了として記録しました。後続 GPU 確認は通りました。'
  en_result='The candidate completed fresh GEN requests of1,024 and32,768 tokens, normal QUIT and the following GPU check.' if good else 'The candidate also stopped at the fresh-free guard; the refused request remains incomplete. The following GPU check passed.'
  ja='''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Gated region alias の実機診断

既存 8K の head 解放・再読込と scratch alias は、fresh GEN を 2 回完了しました。
別の 12K 診断では最初の 1,024 token を完了し、次の 32,768 token は workspace
確保前に容量 guard が拒否しました。要求は 4,886,504,448 bytes、空きは
4,422,336,512 bytes でした。管理側の FATAL メッセージ判定も誤って停止したため、
元の失敗と不完全な観測を保持し、別の閉鎖確認でプロセス終了、GPU、モデルと
provider のハッシュ、障害記録を確認しました。最初の空き値との差
897,024,000 bytes の原因は未帰属です。GPU ハングを示す記録はありません。

新しい候補は FP32 の gated を同じ in-order queue の共有領域に重ねます。
最後の HC mix reader より後に GDN、QSA、MoE が書きます。計算の精度は変えません。
stock 12K での要求量差は padding 込み 503,316,736 bytes です。
exact STRATA_PREFILL_GATED_ALIAS=1 の場合だけ有効で、既定 OFF を維持します。
''' + '\n'+ja_result+'''
実際の chunk、pointer、容量台帳、各要求と終了の結果は summary.json にあります。
この診断は速度、NLL、state の同等性、全物理 262144、restore の証明ではありません。

free と contrib-llvm の全ビルド、CPU Release と ASan / UBSan が通りました。
最初の lint は未知 owner を保持する fixture の漏れを指摘しました。Main は全 assertion
の後に子プロセスを終了することを明示し、fixture を 4 構成で再実行しました。
失敗記録を残し、変更 5 ファイルを実際の親に対して再検査した新規指摘はゼロです。
CPU helper fixture は layout の算術と範囲を検査し、実デバイスの所有権は証明しません。

registry v192 は 939 件です。R389 v1 は HIP / CUDA を調べており今回の対象外です。
元を保持し、v2 で実際の SYCL chooser を調べ直しました。R390 の所有者調査も
897 MB を特定の cache に帰属させていません。R391 は独立した source 監査です。R393 の調査から、既存の未同期で device 別ではない
chooser の値を読むだけでは bound を縮められないため、cold bound を維持します。

速度比較は変更していない上流 bench.sh --long --runs 3 に統一します。
今回の診断時間は速度試行に数えません。固定履歴の分布と state、restore、全物理
コンテキストを確認し、同じ上流 client の 8K / 12K 比較で採否を判断します。
個別の元結果は保持し、閉じた重複ログだけを retention manifest に沿って削除します。
'''
  en='''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Actual gated region alias diagnostics

The existing8K head release/reload and scratch alias completed two fresh GENs.
The separate12K diagnostic completed its first1,024-token request, then refused
32,768 tokens before workspace allocation:4,886,504,448 requested bytes against
4,422,336,512 free bytes. The controller also mismatched the FATAL message. Preserve
that failed status and incomplete observation; a separate closure checked process
exit, GPU health, model/provider hashes and fault records. The897,024,000-byte drop
from initial fresh free remains unattributed. There is no recorded GPU hang.

The candidate overlays FP32 gated output on the shared region of the same in-order
queue. GDN,QSA and MoE write after the last HC mix reader. Precision is unchanged.
Stock12K requested storage drops by503,316,736 bytes including padding. The exact
STRATA_PREFILL_GATED_ALIAS=1 opt-in remains default OFF.
'''+'\n'+en_result+'''
summary.json retains actual chunks,pointers,capacity ledgers,requests and exit results.
These diagnostics prove no speed,NLL,state equivalence,full physical262144 or restore.

Full free and contrib-llvm builds and CPU Release/ASan/UBSan checks passed. The first
lint found a retained unknown-owner fixture leak. Main made child exit explicit
after all assertions and rechecked the fixture in four configurations. Preserve the
original failure. All five changed files passed the no-new-findings comparison with
the actual parent. CPU helpers verify layout arithmetic/ranges,not device ownership.

Registry v192 holds939 reports. R389 v1 inspected HIP/CUDA,out of scope here; retain
it and the v2 correction for actual SYCL chooser behavior. R390 does not attribute
the897 MB to a particular cache. R391 independently audits candidate source. R393 finds that a getter over the old
unkeyed,unsynchronized chooser cannot safely narrow the bound; retain the cold bound.

Speed comparisons use unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3. Diagnostic times
are excluded. Qualify fixed-history distributions/state,restore and full physical
context,and compare8K/12K with the same upstream client before adoption. Preserve
individual original outcomes and retire only closed duplicates through the manifest.
'''
  (F/'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja);(F/'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
  manifest=dict(owner='Main',deleted=False,deletions=deletions,original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,byte_budget=4<<20,consumer='Production fixed-history serve capture and next official capacity A/B; unresolved physical897MB accounting',next_review='After production logits capture and next capacity comparison',active_runs_touched=False)
  dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',manifest)
  files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
  output=run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files]);assert 'skipped (' not in output
  run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check'])
  assert all(m.sha(p)==v for p,v in pins.items()) and all(m.sha(W/k)==v for k,v in build['source_pins'].items())
  for row in deletions:assert m.sha(row['path'])==row['sha256']
  for row in deletions:Path(row['path']).unlink()
  manifest.update(deleted=True,removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in deletions));dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',manifest)
  run('stage',['git','add','--',*build['source_pins'],str(F.relative_to(W))])
  run('commit',['git','commit','-m','feat(xe): reuse retired gated storage and qualify actual phase lifetime'])
  r['commit']=run('committed-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
  run('push',['git','push','-u','origin','feat/prefill-gated-region-alias-20261013'])
  assert not run('status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
  r.update(passed=True,complete=True,removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in deletions),report_file_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
 except BaseException as error:r['error']=repr(error)
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','complete','error','commit','removed_files','removed_logical_bytes')}),flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
